who: Real stack · local stand-ins for a Sendcloud-style carrier API and the shop
title: From paid order to tracked parcel, without the copy-paste
sub: Carrier rules with reasons, address and customs checks, one label per order, the day's labels in one PDF, tracking back to the shop and problems surfaced.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · Sendcloud-style carrier API · Shopify fulfillments · signed webhooks · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.

caps.text: Six paid orders arrive from the shop. Each is checked and gets a carrier by rule
DHL Warenpost, DHL to a Packstation, DPD in the EU, DHL Express with customs data. Labels made automatically
One order is on hold: the street has no house number. Fixed here, re-checked, labelled
End of the day: all new labels in one PDF for the printer
Printed parcels are marked shipped in the shop with carrier and tracking. The shop emails the customer
The carrier scans parcels. One is delivered; one address can't be found, and lands under Problems
Every decision explained, every step in the history
